old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_file['content'].splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (case-insensitive)
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title_part, artists_part = song_str.split(' by ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            old_songs.append((title, artists))
        else:
            # No artist info, just title
            old_songs.append((song_str.strip(), []))

# Parse old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists
import re

old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_file['content'].split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by "
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # Maybe just title? But format seems consistent
        old_songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)

# Check if there are more playlists by fetching page 1
page1 = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=1, page_limit=20)
print(page1)

# Collect all unique song IDs from all playlists
all_song_ids = set()
for pl in playlists:
    for sid in pl['song_ids']:
        all_song_ids.add(sid)
print(f"Total unique song IDs: {len(all_song_ids)}")
print(sorted(all_song_ids))

# Parse old songs from the file content
old_songs_content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to separate title and artists
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title_part, artists_part = song_str.split(' by ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
print("Parsed old songs:")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)

# Collect all unique song IDs from all playlists
all_song_ids = set()
for playlist in apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_login['access_token'], page_limit=20):
    all_song_ids.update(playlist['song_ids'])
print("All unique song IDs:", all_song_ids)

        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        songs_to_archive.append((title, artists))

# Parse the archive file content to extract song titles and artists
lines = file_data['content'].strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist"
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        parts = line[2:].rsplit(' by ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist = parts[1].strip()
            songs_to_archive.append((title, artist))
print(f"Parsed {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive")
for t, a in songs_to_archive:
    print(f"  {t} by {a}")

# Create set of song IDs to archive
archive_song_ids = {song_id for song_id, _, _ in song_ids_to_archive}
print(f"Archive song IDs: {archive_song_ids}")

# Old Songs playlist ID
old_songs_playlist_id = 654

# Track which songs have been added to Old Songs to avoid duplicates
added_to_old = set()

# Iterate over all playlists except Old Songs
for playlist in all_playlists:
    if playlist["playlist_id"] == old_songs_playlist_id:
        continue
    playlist_id = playlist["playlist_id"]
    playlist_title = playlist["title"]
    song_ids = playlist["song_ids"]
    # Find songs in this playlist that are in archive
    to_remove = [sid for sid in song_ids if sid in archive_song_ids]
    if not to_remove:
        print(f"Playlist '{playlist_title}' (id {playlist_id}): no archive songs")
        continue
    print(f"Playlist '{playlist_title}' (id {playlist_id}): removing {len(to_remove)} songs: {to_remove}")
    for sid in to_remove:
        # Remove from this playlist
        apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=login_result["access_token"])
        # Add to Old Songs if not already added
        if sid not in added_to_old:
            apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=old_songs_playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=login_result["access_token"])
            added_to_old.add(sid)
            print(f"  Added song {sid} to Old Songs")
        else:
            print(f"  Song {sid} already in Old Songs, skipping add")

print(f"\nTotal unique songs added to Old Songs: {len(added_to_old)}")

    else:

# Parse the file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

lines = file_data['content'].strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " to get title and artists part
        if ' by ' in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
        else:
            # No artists? skip or handle
            pass

print(f"Parsed {len(songs_to_archive)} songs:")
for s in songs_to_archive:
    print(s)

# Search for each song in the list to find its song_id
# We'll use spotify.search_songs with the title as query, then match by title and artists
import re

# We already have songs_to_archive list from previous step
# Let's search for each song and store the song_id
song_ids_to_archive = []

for song in songs_to_archive:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
    # Find matching result
    found = None
    for r in results:
        # Check title match (case-insensitive)
        if r['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if all artists are present
            result_artist_names = [a['name'] for a in r['artists']]
            # Check if all required artists are in result_artist_names
            if all(any(art.lower() == ra.lower() for ra in result_artist_names) for art in artists):
                found = r
                break
    if found:
        song_ids_to_archive.append(found['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {title} -> song_id {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print(f"\nTotal found: {len(song_ids_to_archive)}")

# Build a mapping of song titles to their Spotify song IDs by searching each song
import json

# The list of songs to archive (from file parsing)
songs_to_archive = [
    {'title': 'City of Fallen Angels', 'artists': ['Hazel Winter']},
    {'title': 'Sacred Ground', 'artists': ['Noah Bennett']},
    {'title': 'Echoes from the Abyss', 'artists': ['Noah Bennett']},
    {'title': 'Beneath the Surface of Love', 'artists': ['Velvet Echo']},
    {'title': 'Lost in the Maze of Your Mind', 'artists': ['Noah Bennett']},
    {'title': 'Crimson Veil', 'artists': ['Phoenix Rivers']},
    {'title': 'In the Wake of Goodbye', 'artists': ['Lucas Grey']},
    {'title': 'The Puzzle of My Heart', 'artists': ['Jasper Skye', 'Isabella Cruz', 'Seraphina Dawn']},
    {'title': "A Broken Heart's Lament", 'artists': ['Lucas Diaz']},
    {'title': 'Whispers of a Forgotten Love', 'artists': ['Lily Moon', 'Zoey James']},
    {'title': 'Strangers Again', 'artists': ['Oceanic Odyssey']},
    {'title': 'When Dawn Breaks Without You', 'artists': ['Lucas Grey']},
    {'title': 'Secrets of the Heart', 'artists': ['Carter Knight']}
]

# We'll search for each song and get its song_id
song_id_map = {}
for song in songs_to_archive:
    title = song['title']
    # Search using the title (and maybe artist to disambiguate)
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token)
    # Find the matching song in the results
    # The result is a list of songs; we need to match by title and artist(s)
    found = None
    for s in result:
        if s['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if artists match (at least one artist name matches)
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in s['artists']]
            # Check if any of the expected artists is in the song's artists
            if any(artist in song_artists for artist in song['artists']):
                found = s
                break
    if found:
        song_id_map[title] = found['song_id']
    else:
        print(f"Could not find song: {title}")

print("Song ID map:", song_id_map)
print("Number of songs mapped:", len(song_id_map))

# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release dates
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_to_fix = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" from artists_part
            artists_part = artists_part.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
            # Split artists by comma
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            songs_to_fix.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists})
print(songs_to_fix)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release month
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        m = re.match(r'- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (TODO|\d{2}/\d{4})', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1)
            artists = m.group(2)
            release = m.group(3)
            if release == 'TODO':
                songs_todo.append((title, artists))
print(songs_todo)

lines = original_content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: it's the part after "- " and before " BY "
        # Actually the format is "- Song Title BY Artist(s) RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We can find the song title by splitting on " BY " and taking first part after "- "
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        song_title = parts[0].lstrip('- ').strip()

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
note_content = """# Liked Songs
- Haunted Memories BY Apollo Serenade, Phoenix Rivers RELEASED_AT 11/2022
- Gone Astray BY Aria Sterling RELEASED_AT 06/2021
- Heartstrings Symphony BY Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT 12/2022
- Tangled Lies BY Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO
- Lost in the Wilderness of Love BY Lily Moon, Zoey James RELEASED_AT TODO
- Whispers of a Forgotten Love BY Lily Moon, Zoey James RELEASED_AT TODO
- Lost in the Twilight of Hope BY Felix Blackwood RELEASED_AT TODO
- The Distance Between Two Hearts BY Jasper Skye RELEASED_AT TODO
- When All Hope Seems Lost BY Seraphina Dawn RELEASED_AT TODO
- The Forgotten Pages of Time BY Luna Starlight RELEASED_AT TODO
- Summer's End BY Ethan Wallace RELEASED_AT TODO
- A Tale of Unspoken Longing BY Emily Rivers RELEASED_AT TODO
- Cracks in the Facade of Love BY Velvet Echo RELEASED_AT TODO
- A Fading Reflection in Water BY Lucas Grey RELEASED_AT TODO
- Trapped in a Daydream BY Nova Harmony RELEASED_AT TODO
- Mystic Voyage to Avalon BY Nova Harmony RELEASED_AT TODO
"""

songs_todo = []
for line in note_content.split('\n'):
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            # Extract artists part before " RELEASED_AT "
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_str, released = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                if released == 'TODO':
                    songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists_str})
print(songs_todo)

# Get Spotify password from supervisor
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pass = [p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name'] == 'spotify'][0]
print(spotify_pass)

# Now let's check the update_note API signature
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='simple_note', api_name='update_note'))

# Build the updated content with release months
import re

# Original content
content = note['content']

# Mapping from song title to release month/year (MM/YYYY)
release_map = {
    'Tangled Lies': '12/2022',
    'Lost in the Wilderness of Love': '02/2022',
    'Whispers of a Forgotten Love': '02/2022',
    'Lost in the Twilight of Hope': '07/2022',
    'The Distance Between Two Hearts': '11/2018',
    'When All Hope Seems Lost': '04/2022',
    'The Forgotten Pages of Time': '09/2020',
    "Summer's End": '04/2022',
    'A Tale of Unspoken Longing': '02/2022',
    'Cracks in the Facade of Love': '07/2020',
    'A Fading Reflection in Water': '07/2020',
    'Trapped in a Daydream': '04/2021',
    'Mystic Voyage to Avalon': '08/2020'
}

# Process each line
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title (between "- " and " BY")
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY ', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1)
            if title in release_map:
                line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {release_map[title]}')
            else:
                print(f"Warning: No release date for {title}")
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)

    "Mystic Voyage to Avalon": "08/2020"
}

# Get the current note content
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title from the line: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # The title is between "- " and " BY "
        title_part = line.split(' BY ')[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
        if title_part in release_map:
            line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f"RELEASED_AT {release_map[title_part]}")
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)

# Search for each song and get release month
# We'll use the spotify_token from earlier
# For each song, search and find the matching one

# Let's define a helper to search and extract release month
def get_release_month(title, artists_str):
    # Build query: title + " " + artists (maybe just title)
    query = title
    # Search
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find matching song
    for song in result:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists match
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            # Compare with expected artists (split by comma)
            expected_artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            # Check if all expected artists are in song_artists (order may differ)
            if all(any(ea.lower() == sa.lower() for sa in song_artists) for ea in expected_artists):
                # Extract release month/year
                release_date = song['release_date']  # e.g., "2021-03-23T13:53:26"
                # Parse month and year
                year = release_date[:4]
                month = release_date[5:7]
                return f"{month}/{year}"
    return None

# Test with first song

# Parse the note content to find songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists part
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, artists_part = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # artists_part ends with " RELEASED_AT TODO"
            artists_part = artists_part.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Unexpected format:", line_clean)
print("Songs with TODO:", len(todo_songs))
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re
lines = note['content'].split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
        # Use regex to extract title, artists, and release part
        m = re.match(r'- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            release = m.group(3).strip()
            if release == 'TODO':
                songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists_str, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

import re

todo_songs = []
for line in todo_lines:
    # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)

        title = m.group(1)
        artists_str = m.group(2)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those with TODO
import re

note_content = note['content']
lines = note_content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading '- '
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on ' BY ' to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            # Split on ' RELEASED_AT ' to get artists and release info
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                release = release_part.strip()
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
            else:
                # No RELEASED_AT? Shouldn't happen
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': [], 'release': None})
        else:
            # No BY? skip
            pass

# Print songs with TODO
for s in songs:
    if s['release'] == 'TODO':
        print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

GOAL
I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

CONSTRAINTS
- Note 'Songs I have Liked' has note_id 3084; content uses format '- Song Title BY Artist(s) RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY' for entries that have release month.
- Some songs already have RELEASED_AT (e.g., 'The Fragrance of Fading Roses' has 10/2022).
- Spotify search_songs returns release_date in ISO format; need to extract month/year.

CREDENTIALS (still bound; reuse, do not re-login): access_token = simple_note.login[login_result](...); login_result = { "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90...; simple_note_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90ZStjZS1tYWxkb25hZG...; simple_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90ZStjZS1tYWxkb25hZG...; spotify_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NlLW1hbGRvbmFkb0BnbW...

PLAN  ([x] done  [>] active  [ ] pending  [!] blocked  [-] invalidated; open nodes list what they carry)
[>] c1 Parse note 3084 content to list all songs and identify which lack RELEASED_AT.  -- Need to fetch full note content; observations truncated.
    api : simple_note.show_note(note_id:integer, access_token:string) -> {note_id, title, content, tags, created_at, updated_at, p...
    call: simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
    var : note = { "note_id": 3084, "title": "Songs I have Liked", "content": "# Songs I have Liked\n- The Fragrance of Fading Roses BY J...
[ ] c2 For each song missing RELEASED_AT, search Spotify to get release month.

all_liked = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    # Assuming response is a list of songs
    if not page:
        break
    all_liked.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(all_liked)}")
# Print first few to see structure
print(all_liked[:2])

# Parse the note content to extract songs and their current release month status
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
        # Use regex to extract title, artists, and release info
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            release_info = m.group(3).strip()
            songs.append({
                'title': title,
                'artists': [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')],
                'release_info': release_info
            })
print(f"Parsed {len(songs)} songs")
for s in songs:
    print(s)

# Parse note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artist part
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We'll split on " BY " and then on " RELEASED_AT "
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            rest = parts[1].strip()
            # rest contains "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
            # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artist_part, released = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                if released.strip() == 'TODO':
                    songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artist_part.strip()})
print(songs_todo)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(todo_songs)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify which need release info
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_str, release_info = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release_info': release_info.strip()})
            else:
                # malformed
                pass
        else:
            # malformed
            pass

# Print songs that need TODO
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release_info'] == 'TODO']
print("Songs needing release info:")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

# Parse the note content to identify songs needing release month
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part, released_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                released = released_part.strip()
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'released': released, 'line': line})
            else:
                # No RELEASED_AT? treat as TODO
                artists = [a.strip() for a in rest.split(',')]
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'released': 'TODO', 'line': line})
        else:
            # No BY? skip or handle
            pass

# Print songs with TODO
for s in songs:
    if s['released'] == 'TODO':
        print(s)

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release month info
import re

note_content = note['content']
lines = note_content.split('\n')
songs_to_process = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2, ... RELEASED_AT TODO
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_to_process.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")

print(f"Found {len(songs_to_process)} songs to process")
for s in songs_to_process:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
note_content = """# Songs I have Liked
- The Fragrance of Fading Roses BY Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn RELEASED_AT 10/2022
- The Puzzle of My Heart BY Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn RELEASED_AT 10/2022
- Lost in a Moment's Grace BY Apollo Serenade, Phoenix Rivers RELEASED_AT 11/2022
- In the Depths of Despair BY Apollo Serenade, Phoenix Rivers RELEASED_AT 11/2022
- Lost in the Embrace of Night BY Noah Bennett RELEASED_AT TODO
- Lonely Skies BY Aria Sterling RELEASED_AT TODO
- Caught in a Web of Lies BY Hazel Winter, Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO
- On the Border of Reality BY Lily Moon, Zoey James RELEASED_AT TODO
- A Love That Never Was BY Mia Sullivan, Carter Knight RELEASED_AT TODO
- Astral Serenity BY Orion Steele RELEASED_AT TODO
- Between Reality and Reverie BY Aria Sterling RELEASED_AT TODO
- Strangers Again BY Oceanic Odyssey RELEASED_AT TODO
- The Mirage of a Perfect Life BY Soulful Reverie RELEASED_AT TODO
- Wilted Roses on the Vine BY Velvet Echo RELEASED_AT TODO
- When All Words Fail Us BY Marcus Lane RELEASED_AT TODO
- Final Echo BY Hazel Winter RELEASED_AT TODO"""

lines = note_content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2, ... RELEASED_AT ...
        # Find " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
        by_idx = line.find(' BY ')
        released_idx = line.find(' RELEASED_AT ')
        if by_idx == -1 or released_idx == -1:
            continue
        title = line[2:by_idx].strip()
        artists_str = line[by_idx+4:released_idx].strip()
        released = line[released_idx+len(' RELEASED_AT '):].strip()
        if released == 'TODO':
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists_str, 'line': line})
print(songs_todo)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

import re

def find_release_month(song_title, artists_str, access_token):
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song_title, access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
    # Parse artists from note
    note_artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
    for song in result:
        if song['title'].lower() == song_title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            # Check if all note artists are in song artists
            if all(any(na.lower() == sa.lower() for sa in song_artists) for na in note_artists):
                release_date = song['release_date']
                # Extract month/year
                month = release_date[5:7]
                year = release_date[0:4]
                return f"{month}/{year}"
    return None

lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            # Split by " RELEASED_AT " to get artists and release info
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                release = release_part.strip()
                if release == 'TODO':
                    songs_todo.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(songs_todo)

    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find matching song
    found = None
    for item in result:
        if item['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            # Check artists match
            item_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in item['artists']]
            note_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in song['artists'].split(',')]
            # Check if all note artists are in item artists

                break
    if found:

# Parse song lines to extract title and artists for missing songs
import re

missing_songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        title = parts[0].strip()
        rest = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        # Split rest on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists
        artists_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0].strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        missing_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(missing_songs)

# Process all missing songs to find their release months
import re
from datetime import datetime

# We'll store results: song_title -> release_month_str
release_months = {}

for song in missing_songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search for the song
    search_res = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match: title matches and artist set matches
    found = None
    for item in search_res:
        if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
            if set(item_artists) == set(artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']  # e.g., "2021-03-23T13:53:26"
        # Extract month and year
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
        month_str = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
        release_months[title] = month_str
        print(f"{title} -> {month_str}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("Done processing")

import re

# Parse the note content
lines = note['content'].split('\n')
song_data = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line_clean = line[2:] if line.startswith('- ') else line
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        parts = line_clean.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            rest = parts[1].strip()
            # rest ends with " RELEASED_AT TODO"
            artists_str = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            song_data.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")

print(f"Found {len(song_data)} songs to process")

title_to_month_year = {}
for song in liked_songs:

    release_date = release_dates[song_id]
    # Extract month and year
    from datetime import datetime
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
    month_year = dt.strftime('%m/%Y')
    title_to_month_year[title] = month_year

# Now parse the note content and replace TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: part before " BY "
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We'll split on " BY " and take first part, then strip leading "- " and spaces
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            song_title = parts[0].strip().lstrip('- ').strip()
            if song_title in title_to_month_year:

# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release months.
import re
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        # Extract title and artists
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            songs_todo.append((title, artists))
print(songs_todo)

# Let's parse the note content and identify songs with TODO release dates.
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artist
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artist part
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist_part = parts[1].split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0].strip()
            # Take first artist
            first_artist = artist_part.split(',')[0].strip()
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artist': first_artist, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} songs with TODO release dates")

# Let's check the update_note API to know how to update the note content.
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='simple_note', api_name='update_note'))

# Let's parse the note content to get the list of songs that need release months.
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and possibly RELEASED_AT
            # Check if RELEASED_AT TODO is present
            if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in rest:
                # Remove the RELEASED_AT TODO part
                artists_part = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
                songs_todo.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists_part})
print(songs_todo)

# Let's search for release dates for all songs that need them.
# We'll search each song and extract the release_date from the first matching result.
release_dates = {}
for song in songs_todo:
    query = f"{song['title']} {song['artists']}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query)
    # Find the first result that matches the title (case-insensitive)
    found = None
    for r in results:
        if r['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            # Optionally check artists, but we'll trust the first match
            found = r
            break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']
        # Extract month and year
        # release_date format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"
        month = release_date[5:7]
        year = release_date[0:4]
        release_month = f"{month}/{year}"
        release_dates[(song['title'], song['artists'])] = release_month
        print(f"{song['title']} - {release_month}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']}")

new_lines = []
for line in lines:

        # Extract title and artists from the line
        line_content = line[2:]  # remove "- "
        title_part, rest = line_content.split(' BY ', 1)
        artists_part = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()

        if key in release_dates:
            month = release_dates[key]
            new_line = f"- {title_part} BY {artists_part} RELEASED_AT {month}"
            new_lines.append(new_line)
        else:
            # Should not happen, but keep as is
            new_lines.append(line)
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: part before " BY "
        # Line format: "- Song Title BY Artist RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Find " BY " and take the part after "- " and before " BY "
        start = line.find('- ') + 2
        end = line.find(' BY ')
        song_title = line[start:end]
        if song_title in song_release_dates:
            release = song_release_dates[song_title]
            line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {release}')
        else:
            print(f"Warning: No release date for {song_title}")
    new_lines.append(line)
new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
